title: Where 0.2727… sits
caption: 0.272727… is exactly 3/11: it lies between 0.27 and 0.28, a little past 0.27, and never reaches 0.273.
alt: A number line from 0.2 to 0.3 with a point at 3/11 = 0.2727…, just right of 0.27.
description: The line runs from 0.20 to 0.30 with small marks every 0.01.
The point 3/11 sits just to the right of 0.27, at 0.2727…
Because 3/11 is a fraction of integers it is rational, even though its decimal never ends.
